description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 5th Amendment for Service Minute of the Audit Examiners' Service
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Service Minute of the Audit Examiners' Service, which falls under public service administration. It deals with service structure, cadre positions, salary scales, and implementation by the Public Service Commission. This content specifically relates to public sector service conditions and administrative matters, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
